description: 桃園煉油廠廢氣燃燒塔使用事件 [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣中油股份有限公司. 廢氣燃燒塔使用事件公告係依據【揮發性有機物空氣污染管制及排放標準】，當本事業部廢氣燃燒塔總廢氣排放量累積超過30KS時. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣中油股份有限公司. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-25 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
